 Nifty Prediction Today – November 11, 2026: Nifty futures: Intraday outlook is positive  
 Nifty (Nov) futures can rebound from 25,300-25,375 price band and touch 25,600
 By Akhil Nallamuthu BL Research Bureau 
 Updated - November 11, 2026 at 10:45 AM. × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/portfolio/technical-analysis/nifty-prediction-today-november-11-2026-nifty-futures-intraday-outlook-is-positive/article71688392.ece Copy Nifty 50 opened today’s session with a gap-up at 25,338 versus Monday’s close of 25,045. It is now trading at 25,370, up 1.3 per cent.
 The Nifty 50 advances/ declines ratio now stands at 45/5, showing strong buying interest. InterGlobe Aviation and Mahindra & Mahindra, up over 4 per cent each, are the top gainers. 
 On the other hand, Dr Reddy’s Laboratories and Sun Pharmaceuticals, down 0.7 and 0.6 per cent, are the weakest among the Nifty 50 constituents.
 Among the sectors, the few indices related to pharma and healthcare are in the red. Nifty Pharma has lost the most by declining 0.5 per cent.
 While most of the sectoral indices have advanced over 1 per cent, showing a strong broad-based buying, Nifty PSU Bank tops the chart by gaining 2.3 per cent.
 The price action of the Nifty 50 and Nifty futures continues to exhibit positive inclination, Below is an analysis.
 Nifty 50 futures 
 Nifty (Nov) futures began today’s session higher at 25,320 versus Monday’s close of 25,033. The contract is now trading at 25,420, up 1.9 per cent.
 The contract has stayed above the 25,000-mark since the beginning of the week, indicating considerable bullish bias. On the chart, there are no signs of a reversal in trend.
 With respect to the intraday trend, as long as Nifty futures remain above 25,300, the bias will be bullish. The probability of the November contract extending the rally today appears high.
 From the current level of 25,420, it can rise to 25,600. A breakout of this can extend the rally to 25,800. On the other hand, if the contract slips below the support at 25,300, the downtrend can extend to 25,125, a support. Subsequent support is at 25,000.
 Overall, given the prevailing price action, the intraday outlook is positive and so traders can consider long positions.
 Trading strategy 
 Buy Nifty (Nov) futures at 25,375 with a stop-loss at 25,250. Book profits at 25,600.
 After initiating, in case neither target nor stop-loss is triggered today, consider carrying the position for tomorrow.
 Supports: 25,300 and 25,125
 Resistance: 25,600 and 25,800
